svg.title: Herald architecture: typed plans, one approval gate
svg.desc: A CLI instruction flows through a rules router or a grammar-constrained local classifier into ActionPlan JSON, then validation and policy. Reads and drafts run in an execution loop against a provider port; sends wait for human approval before send_reply and receipt verification. SQLite stores metadata, actions, approvals and audit events, while local inference stays behind the model-never-executes boundary.

g.text: One typed action at a time
The model plans. Rust validates, authorizes and executes. A human approves every send.

g.font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
